transit.text:
Chiron can spend several years in your 1st house, making your physical presence and visibility feel extra sensitive. You might notice your posture, feel awkward in photos, or catch yourself constantly apologizing for taking up space. Old comments about your looks, personality, or presence might still dictate how you walk into a room.

This transit is not asking for fake confidence every single day. It is simply making it harder to live like you have to look, sound, or act differently before you deserve to show up. Over time, you become the person who makes space for others because you know what it feels like to be excluded.

transit.text:
Chiron in your 2nd house surfaces old doubts about money, self-worth, and what your labor is actually worth. You might undercharge, over-deliver, delay sending invoices, or feel guilty spending money on yourself even when it is totally reasonable. That insecurity usually spikes right when you need to state your rates or ask for a raise.

Money does not define your value, but fear does not get to set your price either. Naming a fair price, sticking to a realistic budget, or making a purchase without feeling guilty proves to yourself that your basic needs matter.

transit.text:
Chiron in your 3rd house makes speaking up, writing, learning, and everyday conversations feel vulnerable. You might over-rehearse simple sentences, tone down your opinions until they lose all impact, or replay old memories of being called slow, loud, or weird. That old criticism happened long ago, but it still limits how much you speak up today.

Confidence builds through basic practice. Asking a quick question, sharing an opinion in a low-stakes setting, or writing a page without worrying if it is good matters far more than crafting one perfect statement. You do not need to be fearless to speak your mind.

transit.text:
As Chiron moves through your 4th house, family history and what "home" means get emotionally complicated. Childhood memories, strained relationships with parents, recurring holiday fights, or old living situations resurface because your present life is still tiptoeing around them. Understanding where these patterns started helps, especially if you have spent years blaming yourself for a family role forced on you early on.

The past does not have to be your permanent home. This transit helps you build a living space and private life that reflect who you are today, even if your family does not fully get it. Repair might look like a frank conversation, therapy, setting distance, moving, or establishing house rules you actually enforce.

You might remember someone mocking your artwork, a crush you were too embarrassed to pursue, or the exact moment you decided being passionate made you look foolish. The result is often a life where you only put things out there if a positive reaction is guaranteed.

This transit invites you back to being a beginner. Taking a class, writing a messy first draft, going on an awkward date, or showing work to one trusted friend breaks the idea that joy must be flawless to be valid. The real risk is not looking inexperienced; it is letting old embarrassment rob you of fun.

Chiron in your 6th house forces you to look at the link between your workload, your need to be helpful, and your physical health. A heavy workload can easily trigger the belief that asking for help means you are failing.

This transit is not a punishment, but it makes an unsustainable routine impossible to ignore. A doctor's visit, reduced hours, better sleep, or a schedule that accounts for tough days helps you learn that your health is not the entry fee for being reliable.

For about a year, confidence sits closer to the surface: you feel more secure in who you are and the impression you make, and the old urge to hide your talents or hang back loses its grip. Opportunities and useful people tend to show up with less effort than usual, mostly because you stopped standing behind yourself.

One correction keeps the year honest: the assignment is to look at the truth of who you are, not to inflate it. The truth is adequate. Say yes more often this year, take up the room you actually occupy, and let the learning come in. The sign Jupiter is crossing shows how this year of growth expresses itself.

Jupiter crossing Leo through your 1st house turns the growth year radiant. The truth-not-inflation rule matters most here: the year grows what is real about you, and the audience can tell the difference.

exact.text:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 5th house, bringing more attention to creativity, romance, pleasure, children, and the parts of your life that exist because you enjoy them rather than because somebody assigned them to you. A project that has been sitting half-finished may suddenly feel worth taking seriously, dating can become more active, or you may realize that you have spent so much time being useful that you have become strangely uncomfortable doing something simply because it makes you happy. Leo makes self-expression easier to see here, so work that used to stay private may finally be shared, celebrated, published, performed, or given enough time to become something other people can respond to.

The opportunity is not to turn every hobby into a business or every good date into a five-year plan, but to give more time to the parts of your life that remind you that pleasure can produce something valuable without needing to justify itself first. Jupiter can make the 5th house extravagant, which means you may spend more, promise more, or take bigger emotional risks because the excitement feels convincing in the moment. Let yourself make the thing, take the trip, fall in love, celebrate, or show up more boldly than usual, but pay attention to the difference between a life that has more joy in it and a life that needs constant stimulation to feel interesting. The best thing you build this year may be the part of your schedule that finally belongs to you.

exact.text:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 7th house, expanding relationships, partnerships, contracts, clients, and the part of your life where another person’s choices have a direct effect on yours. You may meet more people, enter a significant relationship, attract larger clients, formalize a partnership, or discover that an existing connection has reached the point where the two of you need clearer terms because there is more at stake than there used to be. Leo brings warmth and generosity to one-on-one relationships, which can make this a deeply supportive year, but it can also make admiration feel so good that practical incompatibilities are easy to postpone.

Someone being enthusiastic about you is not the same as being able to build a life, business, or agreement with you. Pay attention to what happens after the chemistry, praise, opportunity, or big promise has had time to become ordinary, because that is when schedules, money, communication, responsibility, and follow-through start telling you what the relationship can actually support. Let people love you loudly this year, but make sure they can also show up when nobody is watching.

Jupiter is moving through your 7th house, one of the best years for the one-to-one bonds: forming them, repairing them, making them official. Partnerships of every kind work in your favor, helpful people appear right when needed, and marriage in particular works well under this transit.

exact.text:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 8th house, bringing attention to shared money, debt, taxes, inheritance, investments, intimacy, and the agreements that determine who carries what when resources and responsibilities are combined. You may receive financial support, restructure debt, merge finances, deal with an estate, secure funding, or enter a relationship where the practical questions around trust become impossible to treat as separate from the emotional ones. Leo can make generosity larger here, but it can also make pride interfere with conversations about who owes what, who has access, and who gets to make decisions once money or responsibility is shared.

This is a good year to improve the terms, not to pretend terms are unnecessary because everybody involved has good intentions. Put the numbers in writing, understand what you are signing, ask who controls the account, and do not confuse somebody’s willingness to spend generously with their willingness to share power. Jupiter can increase what is available to you through other people, but the arrangement works best when nobody has to stay confused in order to keep the peace.

You may return to school, travel farther, publish your work, begin teaching, enter a legal or academic process, or become much more serious about an idea that used to live mostly in conversation. Leo gives conviction to this part of the chart, which can help you speak with more confidence about what you know, especially after a period of collecting information without deciding what you actually believe.

The risk is becoming so attached to the idea that you are right that curiosity starts disappearing from the process. Jupiter likes big explanations and Leo likes confidence, but the strongest argument still has to survive new information, particularly when somebody with less status, fewer credentials, or a different background notices something you missed. Let the world get bigger this year without requiring every new experience to confirm what you already thought.

You might refuse to keep the peace by sweeping things under the rug, protecting the most difficult family member, or playing the scapegoat. exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 5th house brings creative, romantic, and personal desires out of hiding. You might return to an unconventional art form, admit an inconvenient crush, or feel angry about how much fun you sacrificed after someone made you feel stupid for enjoying it. Desire gets loud when it has been treated like something to be ashamed of.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 6th house makes resentment about work, routines, and physical limits impossible to write off as just a bad mood. You become acutely aware of unpaid work, extra duties dumped on you without asking, or a work schedule that completely ignores your health. Burnout is what happens long after "no" was the answer.

The solution is not always quitting on the spot. It looks like turning down tasks that are not your responsibility, holding firm on deadlines, taking real breaks, and admitting that your reliability has been taken for granted. A clean, firm "no" works better than an angry exit.

Black Moon Lilith in your 7th house brings hidden imbalances in close relationships right out into the open. You will be far less willing to swallow your anger, let the other person make all the choices, or play the easygoing partner just to avoid a fight. Resentment always highlights where an unfair dynamic was accepted instead of negotiated.

Do not throw away a good relationship over minor flaws before giving the other person a chance to step up.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 9th house makes inherited beliefs, religious dogmas, and authority figures fair game for questioning. You might challenge a teacher, reject a tradition, or admit that a philosophy you were taught does not match your real life. That break feels uncomfortable when fitting in required you to repeat the approved script.

Rebellion for its own sake is not true freedom. Simply opposing everything still lets someone else's rules control your attention. Build a core set of beliefs that survives your own tough questions, rather than picking a stance just to irritate the people who taught you.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 10th house exposes how much of your professional image was built around being palatable. You will feel far less willing to downplay your authority, let others take credit for your work, or maintain a safe corporate persona that erases your individuality. Frustration naturally bubbles up where your competence was only welcomed as long as you stayed quiet.

You do not need to sabotage your career to prove you are authentic. Claim your proper title, insist on correct credit, set firm professional limits, and let your work sound like you created it. Professional respect and self-respect can exist together.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 11th house highlights the hidden price of staying in certain friendships, groups, or social circles. You become hyper-aware of the opinions you hide, the events you attend purely out of obligation, or the quiet role you play because disagreement would get you ousted. Belonging gets way too expensive when it requires you to censor yourself.

The answer is not burning down every friendship before anyone can criticize you. Test the waters by speaking your mind, skipping an event you hate, or setting a boundary on your time. Real friends do not require your silence to keep you around.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 12th house brings buried anger, unfulfilled longing, and old emotional baggage out of storage. Recurring dreams, sudden bursts of irritation, or old memories surface because shoving them down stops working. What comes up might feel intense, but it is just old energy looking for an exit.

The goal is not to dwell on anger or grief, but to stop letting buried emotions run your life from behind the scenes.

You will feel far less willing to downplay your authority, let others take credit for your work, or maintain a safe corporate persona that erases your individuality. Frustration naturally bubbles up where your competence was only welcomed as long as you stayed quiet.

You do not need to sabotage your career to prove you are authentic. Claim your proper title, insist on correct credit, set firm professional limits, and let your work sound like you created it. Professional respect and self-respect can exist together.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 11th house highlights the hidden price of staying in certain friendships, groups, or social circles. You become hyper-aware of the opinions you hide, the events you attend purely out of obligation, or the quiet role you play because disagreement would get you ousted. Belonging gets way too expensive when it requires you to censor yourself.

The answer is not burning down every friendship before anyone can criticize you. Test the waters by speaking your mind, skipping an event you hate, or setting a boundary on your time. Real friends do not require your silence to keep you around.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 12th house brings buried anger, unfulfilled longing, and old emotional baggage out of storage. Recurring dreams, sudden bursts of irritation, or old memories surface because shoving them down stops working. What comes up might feel intense, but it is just old energy looking for an exit.

Give yourself privacy and a safe place to process. Journaling, therapy, or a private talk with a trusted friend helps separate what is actually yours from stress you absorbed from others. The goal is not to dwell on anger or grief, but to stop letting buried emotions run your life from behind the scenes.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith spends about nine months in your 1st house, making it almost impossible to keep hiding the parts of yourself you toned down to please others. You might stop softening your opinions, refuse to dress for anyone else's approval, or stop laughing off things that bother you. That sudden edge is useful; it shows exactly where you have been compromising your personality.

The trap is picking fights just to prove a point. Acting out is not the same thing as being free. Restore the parts of yourself you hid because they belong to you, not just to shock an audience.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 2nd house makes your true desires around money, comfort, possessions, and lifestyle impossible to pass off as mere "practicality." You might finally admit the income you want, the quality you prefer, or the comforts you denied yourself because wanting them felt greedy or shallow. Resentment builds when you suppress every desire until it explodes in impulse buying.

This is not an excuse to blow your savings or make pointlessly flashy purchases. It is about dropping the guilt around wanting nice things so you can manage your money intentionally. Wanting comfort does not make you a bad person.

exact.text:
With Black Moon Lilith in your 3rd house, swallowed words and unaddressed conversations become too heavy to carry. You will notice how often you dilute a disagreement into vague politeness, leave important texts in drafts, or rewrite your point so it does not upset anyone. Those unsaid words do not vanish; they show up as low-key resentment toward people who do not even know the full story.

Do not unleash months of pent-up annoyance all at once and label it "being honest." Direct communication still works best with good timing and clear delivery. Speak the clear truth to the person who actually needs to hear it.

exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 4th house shines a light on the family secrets, taboo topics, or toxic relatives everyone pretends not to notice. You might refuse to keep the peace by sweeping things under the rug, protecting the most difficult family member, or playing the scapegoat. exact.text:
Black Moon Lilith in your 6th house makes resentment about work, routines, and physical limits impossible to write off as just a bad mood. You become acutely aware of unpaid work, extra duties dumped on you without asking, or a work schedule that completely ignores your health. Burnout is what happens long after "no" was the answer.

The solution is not always quitting on the spot. It looks like turning down tasks that are not your responsibility, holding firm on deadlines, taking real breaks, and admitting that your reliability has been taken for granted. A clean, firm "no" works better than an angry exit.

Your tolerance for superficial interactions, silent control, or arrangements where your energy or financial resources are quietly being drained evaporates.

This transit forces an honest accounting of what you share and what it actually costs you. You feel a sudden push to untangle joint accounts, clear backlogged debt, face unpaid obligations, or confront a partner over how authority and resources are split. In intimacy, desire turns fierce and undisguised. You crave real depth, leaving no room for cold routine or emotional detachment.

The operational risk is hyper-vigilance. When trust feels fragile or an agreement seems uneven, you risk holding a grievance with a death grip, refusing to drop the thread until every secret is brought into the open. The sign Mars is moving through shows how you defend your vulnerabilities, where you seek leverage, and how you claim back your power.

With Mars in Aquarius in your 8th house, you challenge traditional expectations around intimacy, shared wealth, and emotional dependence. You cut ties with draining contracts, explore non-traditional financial models, or demand full personal autonomy inside a close bond.

You need room to exist without feeling controlled or possessed. A partner may misread your need for space as detachment, sparking conflict when one person tries to loosen the tie while the other is trying to hold it together.

You might hang onto a job, budget, routine, or piece of property because it is predictable, even when it no longer fits the life you are trying to build. Financial caution makes sense, but fear can easily disguise itself as practical thinking.

The 8th house on the other side brings shared finances, joint trust, and obligations you cannot handle all by yourself. This is not about taking foolish risks or giving away what belongs to you. It is about noticing if your version of stability helps you live fully, or only keeps you from needing anyone.

With the South Node moving through your 3rd house, familiar opinions and repetitive conversations keep coming up. You might stay busy with texts, errands, group chats, and small talk to avoid the bigger questions that take real time to answer. Staying informed is not the same thing as letting what you learn change your mind.

The 9th house on the other side calls for something deeper than a quick reply. It asks for genuine perspective gained through experience, study, or travel. The easy answer comes fast, but a conviction takes time to figure out.

You might step back into being the fixer, the mediator, the memory keeper, or the one who hides away when life gets demanding. exact.text:
As the South Node moves through your 5th house, your default habits around dating, hobbies, and seeking validation become obvious. You might stick to romantic partners who fit a predictable pattern, reuse creative ideas that worked before, or rely on compliments to feel good about what you make. Enjoying yourself is great, but relying on what comes easy can turn fun into a routine instead of an actual experience.

The 11th house on the other side shifts the focus to community, shared goals, and friendships where you don't have to be the center of attention. You don't have to give up your hobbies or hand over creative control. Just notice if you are making room for group efforts and mutual support, or if you are keeping your focus strictly on predictable romantic and creative dynamics you already know how to navigate.

Competence keeps chaos at bay, but it can also keep you too busy to notice what the work costs your body and your personal life.

Your attention turns rightly toward yourself: what you need, what comes next, which version of you is finished. You can put yourself across with more force than usual, and it is an excellent few weeks for making an impression.

The known cost is collaboration: you are running on a subjective frame right now, less tuned to what other people need, so joint projects tend to move slower than solo ones. That is not a flaw to fix, it is the assignment. This month, the first duty is to yourself. The sign the Sun is crossing shows how this year's recharge runs.

When the Sun crosses Libra through your 1st house, the recharge is social, which is its own complication. The month asks for self-focus while your instinct reaches for company, so the balance is company that restores instead of costs. You make impressions through grace right now. Practice one unaccompanied decision a week; it is the month's actual homework.

transit.text:
When Venus moves through your 10th house, being liked counts double at work, and doors that effort alone could not budge tend to open through charm. It is the window to ask for what you have been waiting to be handed: the title, the feature, the meeting with the person above your boss. Let the work look as good as it is, because your taste is part of your value here.

The caution is chasing a success that photographs well but does not feel like yours. Take the applause, and make sure the work still matches your values. The sign Venus is moving through shows exactly how that ease gets expressed.

With Venus transiting Virgo in your 10th house, competence becomes charisma. Right now the flawless file, the caught error, and the process that finally runs clean earn a quieter, more durable kind of admiration. Let the standards show, and attach your name to the improvement instead of letting it read as luck.

exact.text: Venus in Virgo moves through your 11th house of friendships and community, so an invitation may get you out of the house, an old friend may come back around, or you may notice which friendships only stay active because you keep making the plan. A group works better when somebody names the job, deadline, and person responsible instead of assuming goodwill will handle it.

transit.text:
When Venus moves through your 11th house, friendship comes easier, and new people tend to arrive through the ones you already know, which is also how love has a habit of showing up under this transit if you are single. Make the plan with the friend you keep meaning to see; the group leans yes this month. It is also the window to join the thing you have been eyeing: the club, the class, the cause.

The caution is becoming everyone's favorite and no one's confidant, because popularity is not the same as belonging. Pick two people and go deeper. The sign Venus is moving through shows exactly how that ease gets expressed.

With Venus transiting Virgo in your 11th house, you are the friend who actually helps. Right now the ride to the airport, the resume review, and the spreadsheet for the group trip say love in your dialect, and people notice who does the quiet work. Help freely, and ask for one favor back; it lets people love you in return.

exact.text: Venus in Virgo moves through your 12th house of endings and closure, so you may want more privacy around who you like and what you enjoy. An old relationship may cross your mind, a new affection may stay out of the group chat, or being home may sound better than going out. Rest is harder when your mind keeps turning recovery into another project to optimize.

transit.text:
When Venus moves through your 12th house, affection goes quiet, and you may find yourself craving the kind of closeness nobody posts about. Honor that: rest counts as romance this month, and the bath, the nap, and the day with your phone off do more for you than any night out. Old patterns in love tend to surface under this transit, which makes it a good window for therapy, journaling, or any practice that reaches under the surface.

The caution is secrecy itself, because a connection that only exists in hiding is not growing, it is just hidden. Give the private feeling one witness, even if it is a notebook. The sign Venus is moving through shows exactly how that ease gets expressed.

With Venus transiting Virgo in your 12th house, quiet order is the self-care. Right now the drawer sorted at midnight, the journal with actual lists, and the routine nobody sees keep you gentle with yourself. Tidy the private corners, and skip the audit of your own heart; this month it only needs tending.
